title: Standalone Postmaclone Tunnel For Shared Anonymized DBs
description: Adds ngramx postmaclone tunnel with --mysql/--psql to open an SSH hop to shared anonymized clusters using factory engine credentials, without patching project .env.

test_plan.description: Open and close a Postgres standalone tunnel
steps: Copy postmaclone.tunnel.example.yml to ~/.config/ngramx/postmaclone.yml and ensure op CLI is signed in
Confirm output shows 127.0.0.1 and a local port, then connect with HeidiSQL using printed user/host/port
Run ngramx postmaclone tunnel --psql --tunnel-disconnect and confirm the tunnel stops

test_plan.description: Custom local port when default is in use
steps: With a tunnel already on 15432, run ngramx postmaclone tunnel --psql --local-port 15433

test_plan.description: Tunnel profile does not break factory produce
steps: From the postmaclone-factory repo run ngramx postmaclone produce --all (or --dry-run if available) and confirm it still loads the repo postmaclone.yml with datasets
Run ngramx postmaclone tunnel --psql and confirm it loads the home tunnel profile

test_plan.description: Review feedback: errors and missing engine
steps: Start a tunnel, run tunnel --psql again without --replace and confirm the error cites --tunnel-disconnect not tunnel disconnect
With a postgres-only tunnel profile, run ngramx postmaclone tunnel --mysql and confirm a clear missing engines.mysql.anon message (no PHP fatal)
